limitations.caveat: RUNTIME INTEGRITY UNVERIFIED (SW PASS-THROUGH). This acceptance record verifies functional, semantic and route-matrix correctness for embeddinggemma-2 across Desktop and Mobile viewports under live WebGPU execution. It DOES NOT verify service-worker runtime integrity. The runtime entrypoint https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@4.3.1 is intercepted by sw.js under LIB_HOSTS but is currently absent from runtime-integrity.json. In accordance with service-worker design, the payload was served pass-through over the network without cryptographic SHA-256 verification and was not written to the trusted shell cache. This run must not be cited as evidence of verified runtime integrity, tamper resistance, or offline runtime caching.
limitations.harnessCountsNote: This record stores passing (route,viewport) cells only. The per-run 61/61 check counts, timings and adapter observations are not stored here and cannot be independently proved from this file.
limitations.measurementEnvironment: Software WebGPU adapter (SwiftShader), emulated desktop/mobile viewports; latency figures are environment-bound and are not hardware performance.
